name: 侠客行一百
group_note: 侠客行一百, 厦门热线一百 (Xiamen Redian) branch, MudOS V22pre11 -- shares the '侠客行一百' title with 110 xkx100 but is a genuinely distinct, smaller snapshot (6456 vs 14255 .lpc files, different directory shape including ftp/mudos.etc/www dirs not present in xkx100), not a duplicate archive despite the confusingly identical display name; not marked duplicate_of. WASM pass fixed the same §7.52-class from-scratch HTTP server bug already seen on xkx2000zxb/xkxyb's own cousins: adm/daemons/httpd.lpc (the classic Truilkan/Jacques Interstice httpd.c, here explicitly annotated in its own header comments as ported to the XAJH mudlib base by xiaobao/ken@XAJH) calls socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_close() directly with no availability guard, failing the whole file's compile under WASM; confirmed zero external callers, so per §7.52's default, gutted every socket-touching function (setup(), write_data_retry(), store_client_info(), listen_callback(), close_connection()'s and remove()'s socket_close calls). No is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug found -- 小浮侠 (3 characters) was accepted on the first attempt with no fix needed, unlike several sibling libs in this pass. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, confirmed via source; wiz_levels tops out at (admin)). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: press-any-key banner -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos listed in the top tier. LPC formatter run across all 6456 .lpc files (6420 written, 19 errors, 17 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 3 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
